newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex Philippines cracker, reformer shut 1Q '97.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Philippines cracker, reformer shut 1Q '97.

text.p: Caltex Philippines, the joint-venture between U.S. majors Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp will carry out maintenance shutdowns only at its secondary refining units during the first quarter of 1997, a company source said on Friday.
"There is no scheduled shutdown of the crude unit," said the source.
He said the 72,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery located in Batangas undergoes total maintenance shutdown once every four years, the last being two years ago.
There were only plans for secondary refining units, including a 12,000-bpd catalytic cracker and a 9,000-bpd reformer in the first quarter for one month, he said.
The source was unable to give more specific dates.
